name: labs/pcdshub__pcdsdevices
title: LCLS TPR trigger channel (pcdsdevices.TprTrigger)
intro: LCLS TPR trigger channel (pcdsdevices.TprTrigger), adapted from pcdshub/pcdsdevices. It reads `channel_enabled`, `trigger_enabled`, `eventrate` and `label`; sets `delay_ns` and `width_ns`; runs `set_trigger_enabled`. `set_trigger_enabled`: enable or disable the configured TPR channel, its trigger output, or both. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/pcdshub__pcdsdevices --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/pcdshub__pcdsdevices --backend fake --mcp
